summary: Example INI inventory with all:vars defaults, a switches parent group, and per-platform vars for become, network_os, user and password. ssh-agent removes the need for passwords, use ansible_ssh_private_key_file per group for multiple keys, and never store plain-text passwords.
questions: How do I set up a multi-vendor network inventory?
How do I use a different SSH key per device group?
Do I need ansible_password if I use ssh-agent?

answer_card.title: Multi-vendor network inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
ansible_connection=ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_user=ansible

[switches:children]
eos
ios
vyos

[eos]
veos01 ansible_host=veos-01.example.net

[eos:vars]
ansible_become=yes
ansible_become_method=enable
ansible_network_os=arista.eos.eos
ansible_user=my_eos_user
```
- With ssh-agent you can drop `ansible_password`.
- With several keys and no agent, set `ansible_ssh_private_key_file=/path/to/key` per group.
- **Never store passwords in plain text**; use Vault.
